variants.name: targeted
variants.data: training-only minimal contrasts and assertion/question/partial variants

checkpoint_selection: grounded exact, then precision/recall; restore best
variant_selection: recall >=88% preferred, then action precision, grounded exact, recall; validation only
material_progress: at least 3 fewer false updates than concurrent control, recall reduction <=4 percentage points, action precision >=95%
acceptance_gate: Separate: action precision >=99%, recall >=80%, correct evidence and portable runtime. A high score on synthetic validation is not production acceptance.
limitation: Targeted package changes data, loss normalization and pair gate together; no isolated causal claim. Targeted has an optional bounded 500-step extension.

fresh_diagnostic.role: Post-selection synthetic diagnostic; never checkpoint, variant or threshold selection; not natural-conversation acceptance

old_68_cases_role: Regression only; scored after model/checkpoint selection
test_policy: Original 120 test conversations remain unscored unless the frozen candidate passes validation precision/recall/evidence gate
recovery: Selected FP32 safetensors only, no ONNX export on GPU. Prefer authenticated SSH byte stream with SHA256 verification; bounded verified-chunk fallback.
runtime_check: Align native ORT 1.30.0 with existing browser ORT Web 1.30.0 in an isolated local export environment.
launch_recovery_update: First allocation reached Ready, but Jupyter exec timed out before any job status existed. The named VM was stopped. SSH probe succeeded, so subsequent launch/poll and archive recovery prefer SSH; no model/data/loss change.
